items.headline: $LYX Under Attack: LUKSO Urges Key Removal Now
items.summary: LUKSO warns Universal Profile holders to remove an attacker key and malicious recovery controller after an exploit. Revoking permissions alone isn't enough — $LYX users must act fast.

items.headline: PancakeSwap Rebrands to Pancake — $CAKE Stays Put
items.summary: The DEX giant shortens its name to reflect its expansion into perps and tokenized stocks. No migration needed — $CAKE holders can relax.

items.headline: $ONDO to Launch Tokenized Anthropic Stock on IPO Day
items.summary: Ondo's ANTon token will track Anthropic shares from day one of the Claude maker's Nasdaq debut. Binance Wallet's xStocks pool already hit its 500M USDC cap hours early.

items.headline: $GRT Whale Drops 300K Deposit, Shakes Curation Market
items.summary: A 300,000 $GRT deposit lifted one deployment's modeled share of The Graph's indexing rewards to 6.2%. Arbitrators declined to penalize self-curation, keeping the burn at 1%.

items.headline: $EIGEN Craters 48% in Four Weeks as Restaking Cools
items.summary: EigenCloud's restaking collateral slid to $4.52B, down 28.5% since Oct. 21. $EIGEN is badly lagging BTC and ETH — capitulation or opportunity?
